data.name: Najam
data.gender_notes: Najam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Najam means 'Dew' or 'Raindrops' in Arabic. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Najm' which means 'drop'. This name is often given to babies born during the rainy season or those born under the zodiac sign of Cancer. The name Najam carries the meaning “Dew” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Najam usually hope their child will grow to embody dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Najam signifies the purity and gentleness of nature. It is believed to bring blessings of rain and fertility. The name is also said to represent the divine blessings that come down in the form of rain and nourish the earth.
data.etymology: Najam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dew.”
